name: sfx
provenance: Authored by hand by the Test Developer (claude-opus-5) for MT-007 RED on 2026-09-15. Wholly synthetic. Its geometry is modelled on the real finding MT-030 E6 / MT-007 PO-1 measured on spikes/MT-002/pages/012.jpg - a probability map that covers art-integrated SFX while the box head covers 0.000 of it - but no pixel of it comes from that scan.
purpose: AC-6. A boxed text blob; a second boxed text blob whose box edge touches an annotated SFX rectangle and sits 4px from the SFX blob, i.e. INSIDE dilation range; and two unboxed SFX blobs. A screentone field at 0.25 covers the whole right-hand band, so a low threshold floods the SFX area and only the box fence keeps it out.

paint.note: the screentone a low threshold bleeds into; covers both S1's annotated rectangle and T2's box
boxed text, far from any SFX
boxed text whose box's exclusive right edge is S1's annotated rectangle's left edge
SFX blob, covered by NO box
second SFX blob, covered by NO box

sfx_rects.note: 68x68 = 4624 px. Begins exactly at T2's box's exclusive right edge, so no accepted box overlaps it by a single pixel, while 2 iterations of a 7x7 kernel from T2's mask reach x=201 - six columns inside it - unless C-4 intersects with the boxes AGAIN after dilating.
70x50 = 3500 px. Far from every box; the second area that makes 'no region overlaps ANY pixel of the annotated SFX area' plural rather than a single geometry.

control_boxes.note: AC-6's named control. Added to `boxes` it must produce a region covering exactly 3600 px of S1's annotated rectangle.

notes: S1's blob is 60x60 = 3600 px and the control box is exactly the same rectangle, so the control's region is 3600 px at EVERY threshold <= 1.0 and EVERY dilation: the blob fills the box, dilation grows it, and the second intersection clips it straight back.
S2's blob is 60x40 = 2400 px inside a 3500 px annotated rectangle.
No box in `boxes` intersects any annotated SFX rectangle, so AC-6 is satisfiable by construction; `control_boxes` is what makes that fact falsifiable rather than vacuous.

Measured in RED against the real page (MT-007 handoff): removing the second intersection leaves SFX pixels at 0 on 012.jpg, because no accepted box there is within 6px of an annotated rectangle. This fixture is what makes D-2 dischargeable at all.
